Plot G-TROPIC data as static or interactive maps

Source: R/gtropic_plot.R
gtropic_plot.Rd

Creates exposure maps, exposure-day or exposure-storm count maps, and storm-track maps from data retrieved by gtropic_data(). This function never retrieves data itself, nor does it recalculate published exposure values, storm distances, or metadata.

Usage

gtropic_plot(
  data,
  type = c("exposure", "count", "track"),
  metric = NULL,
  storm = NULL,
  adm2 = NULL,
  aggregate = NULL,
  threshold = NULL,
  binary = FALSE,
  wind_categories = NULL,
  count_unit = c("storms", "days"),
  facet_by = NULL,
  track = NULL,
  track_map_key = saffir_simpson(),
  track_labels = TRUE,
  track_interval = 6,
  track_legend_position = NULL,
  basemap = c("countries", "admin1", "none"),
  bbox = NULL,
  expand = 2,
  crs = NULL,
  interactive = FALSE,
  palette = NULL,
  direction = NULL,
  gridlines = TRUE,
  title = NULL,
  subtitle = NULL,
  caption = NULL,
  quiet = FALSE,
  ...
)

Arguments

data

A gtropic_data object returned by gtropic_data(), or a named list of equivalent tables.

type

The output type. One of "exposure" (the default), "count", or "track". Exposure maps summarize the specified metric argument; count maps plot exposure-day or exposure-storm counts that meet exposure-specific thresholds; and track maps draw storm track paths.

metric

A supported published metric name, or a character vector of metric names to plot. The metrics are plotted in the order they are given. For type = "exposure", NULL selects every available core metric in this order: "VMAX_SUST_MS", "PRECIP_MM", and "PROP_FLOODED_AREA". For type = "count", it selects the first available count default; type = "track" selects "USA_WIND". Track maps require exactly one of "USA_WIND" or "USA_STATUS". See gtropic_exposures() for all available metrics available for plotting.

storm

Optional character vector of STORM_IDs or STORM_NAMEs used to subset all applicable tables in data. Specifying storms requires that the data object passed in contains the storm_metadata table. STORM_NAMEs are matched case-insensitively. storm = NULL (the default) retains all storms.

adm2

Optional character vector of ADM2_IDs used to subset all applicable tables in data. adm2 = NULL (the default) retains all ADM2 units. For a track map, this retains tracks linked to the selected ADM2 units when the links table is present in data.

aggregate

Summary method for exposure maps: one of "max", "min", "sum", "mean", or "n". aggregate = NULL (the default) uses the metric-specific published default (see the aggregate column of the tables returned by gtropic_exposures() for these defaults). A single value is recycled over metric; multiple values must either be in metric order or be named for every selected metric. Count maps always use "n" and reject another value; this argument is ignored when type = "track" is passed.

threshold

A named list of finite numeric thresholds, with names matching selected metrics. threshold = NULL (the default) uses a built-in threshold where one is defined. Thresholds determine which observations are counted for type = "count" and which areas are classified for binary = TRUE; an explicit threshold is required when no default exists. This argument is ignored when binary = FALSE and type = "exposure" or "track".

binary

Logical; if TRUE, show exposure/count maps as exposed or not exposed using threshold, rather than as a continuous value scale. Defaults to FALSE. Ignored when type = "track".

wind_categories

Optional categorical exposure key or named list of keys. A key is a data frame with category, numeric upper threshold, constant unit, and color columns. It classifies aggregated ADM2 values, retaining every key category in the static and interactive legends even when unobserved. With multiple selected metrics, supply a uniquely named list keyed by selected wind metric; a bare key is allowed only for one selected metric. Keys must use the source metric's unit; conventional spellings of meters per second, such as "m/s" and "meters per second", are treated as compatible. The saffir_simpson() key is allowed only for VMAX_SUST_MS with aggregate = "max", where it means a local sustained-wind equivalent, not a storm status. Other wind metrics or aggregates require an explicitly custom key. Applies only to non-binary exposure maps and wind metrics.

count_unit

The unit counted when type = "count": distinct qualifying "storms" (the default) or "days". It applies only when type = "count" and is otherwise ignored.

facet_by

An optional single column name in the assembled plotting data to use for facets. NULL (the default) adds no extra facet; multiple metrics always receive separate panels. The column must be available after matching and aggregation.

track

Whether to overlay tracks on exposure/count maps. NULL (the default) overlays them when data contains a tracks table; TRUE or FALSE explicitly enables or suppresses the overlay. Track maps always draw tracks regardless of this value.

track_map_key

A data frame defining the discrete color scale used when plotting track points. Defaults to the data frame returned by saffir_simpson(). The track_map_key must contain the following four columns: category, threshold, unit, and color. The unit column must contain a single, constant value, and can be one of: "m/s", "knots", "mph", "km/h". This key controls USA_WIND track points and exposure/count track overlays, but not a USA_STATUS track map. Static wind legends display every category in the supplied key, including categories absent from the plotted observations.

track_labels

Logical; if TRUE (the default), static maps label each storm with more than one valid observation at its first valid position when multiple storms are shown. It is ignored for interactive maps.

track_interval

Interval in UTC hours at which track intensity points are displayed. Can be 3 or 6 (the default). Paths always retain every observation. NULL displays every point. This argument affects type = "track" maps and enabled track overlays.

track_legend_position

Position of per-panel metric scale strips on static exposure/count maps. NULL (the default) places horizontal strips below the panels. Can be one of "top", "bottom", "left", "right", "top left", "top right", "bottom left", or "bottom right". This argument is ignored when type = "track" or interactive = TRUE.

basemap

The Installed Natural Earth layer to use for plotting. Must be one of "countries" (the default), "admin1", or "none". No layers are ever downloaded. basemap = "admin1" requires the optional rnaturalearthhires package.

bbox

Map extent as an sf/sfc object, an sf bbox with a known CRS, or geographic c(xmin, xmax, ymin, ymax). NULL (the default) derives the extent from the plotted geometry and any displayed tracks.

expand

Nonnegative geographic-degree padding added to each side of the map extent after bbox is resolved. Defaults to 2.

crs

A coordinate reference system understood by sf::st_crs(). NULL (the default) selects EPSG:4326 for longitudinal spans under 40 degrees and Equal Earth for wider extents. Static maps use this projection; interactive Leaflet maps are always rendered in geographic coordinates.

interactive

Logical; if TRUE, return an offline Leaflet exposure or count map instead of a ggplot. Defaults to FALSE; track maps cannot be interactive.

palette

Viridis palette name or letter, or a vector of them. NULL (the default) uses metric-specific palettes. One value is recycled over metric; multiple values must be in metric order or named for every metric. It applies to exposure/count fills and a USA_STATUS track map, but is ignored for categorical USA_WIND track points controlled by track_map_key.

direction

Palette direction: 1 (the default) or -1. It accepts the same scalar, positional, and named forms as palette, and applies in the same situations.

gridlines

Logical; if TRUE (the default), static maps show gridlines and longitude/latitude labels. It is ignored for Leaflet maps, which have no static axes.

title, subtitle, caption

Plot labels. Each defaults to NULL, which uses an automatic title/subtitle/caption. A supplied caption replaces the automatic provenance and method caption.

quiet

Logical; if FALSE (the default), report data-preparation progress.

...

Named arguments passed to ggplot2::geom_sf() for static exposure or count polygons, or to leaflet::addPolygons() for interactive polygons. Track plots accept no additional arguments.

Value

A ggplot for static output or a leaflet widget for interactive output.

Details

Maps use the actual date range of contributing observations after storm, ADM2, and linkage filters. Automatic subtitles begin with "Aggregated across" and show the displayed date range. Single-metric titles use readable aggregate labels; multi-metric titles describe the panel set. A single plotted storm prefixes the title, while multiple storms do not alter it. Metric strips use readable aggregate and active-threshold labels. Automatic captions use newline-separated source, retrieval, dataset-provenance, hazard-parameter, track-interval, and plotting-CRS lines. Hazard radii and windows are derived from rows that contributed to the plot.

Track paths are drawn from every supplied observation. By default, constant- size points use saffir_simpson() categories derived from USA_WIND, which is published in knots and converted to the map key's unit before classification. An explicit metric = "USA_STATUS" retains the status-color display.
